name: Gunther's Retreat
summary: On an island in Brightwater Lake, Gunther's Retreat shelters a renegade necromancer. Gunther Arcanus broke free of the Scourge by sheer will, yet trusts no outsider and keeps undead minions near his camp.

sections.title: A Recluse in Brightwater Lake
sections.body:
Mist hangs over Brightwater Lake, where undead sentinels guard Gunther Arcanus's lonely camp. Raised in undeath, Gunther mastered the arcane arts and tore his soul from the Lich King's grip without help.

He mistrusts everyone and believes the undead wandering Lordaeron remain puppets of the Scourge. So Gunther withdrew to the island to practice his craft in peace. His zombie sentinels attack anyone who crosses the water.

faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus, a necromancer, lives on the island. He broke free of the Lich King's control by his own power, and undead thralls guard his camp.

faq.q: Why are the undead on the island hostile?
faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus believes every other undead in Tirisfal remains enslaved by the Scourge. He prizes his independence, so his minions attack anyone who approaches the island.

faq.q: Is Gunther aligned with the Forsaken?
faq.answer: At first, Gunther keeps apart from the Forsaken, though he too is free-willed undead. The authorities in the Undercity seek to prove they have escaped the Lich King's grasp and to recruit his talents.

faq.q: What is the small islet southwest of the retreat?
faq.answer: A tiny, unnamed islet lies just southwest of Gunther's Retreat. It is known as Lillith's Dinner Table, an eerie landmark in Brightwater Lake.

angles.text: As an undead, Gunther Arcanus shares the Forsaken's fate: free of the Lich King, yet wary of a world he believes remains under the Scourge's thrall.
As a mage, you may recognize Gunther's rare feat: his magical will severed the Lich King's mental grip without help.
